emerging_technology: Agentic AI: language-model systems choosing tool actions and using observations across a bounded multi-step task.
intended_application: Proposed chart-review assistant: compare business charts with approved source tables, use read-only SQL/spreadsheet tools, and draft correction notes. Human approval is required; no autonomous publication.
business_need: Investigate whether chart-review effort can be reduced while retaining traceability and analyst accountability.
management_question: How far has agentic AI and the chart-review application diffused, what accelerates/inhibits diffusion, and what timing/peer-position implication follows without making the full adoption decision?
time_horizon: Four-week evidence/learning window; quarterly reassessment over the next 12 months.
additional_context:
Constructed teaching assumptions, not observed enterprise facts. Continuing the Agentic AI/chart-review use case; sandbox availability is an explicit new hypothetical premise for this lab, not a real change at a company. No measured pilot, savings, rollout or peer-installed-base dataset exists. Analysis as of 2026-10-22. Fixed evidence packet:

users_stakeholders: Business analysts, managers, security staff and named report owners
adoption_posture: Aggressive/early-adopter learning posture; willing to invest in a reversible approved synthetic-only experiment while accepting uncertainty. All other facts and restrictions unchanged.
capabilities_constraints: Approved BI tables and manual analyst checks exist. For this NEW constructed Lab 5 scenario, an isolated synthetic/public-data learning sandbox is approved; it contains no live enterprise information. Sensitive production data and external production-model use remain unapproved. No chart-review agent has been implemented or measured. Resources permit one small exploratory study, not production deployment.
risk_consequence_context: Misleading reports may harm decisions; unauthorized data disclosure is consequential. Synthetic draft examples are reversible. Human report ownership stays in place.
